acceptance.given: A candidate or regression proof is produced with one or more shared production dependencies and a recorded binding identity.

oracle.expected: The structured candidate/proof identity includes every shared production dependency; changing a bound dependency invalidates affected earlier proof; replay reconstructs and reuses the original binding identity.
forbidden: A shared production dependency is omitted from candidate or regression identity.
Affected earlier proof remains current after a bound dependency changes.
Replay uses a different binding identity from the original proof.
oracle.observable: Machine-readable identity and validity fields show complete dependency binding, dependency-change invalidation, and same-identity replay.

acceptance.then: The validator output records complete shared-dependency identity, marks affected prior proof invalid after dependency change, and replay uses the reconstructed original identity.
acceptance.when: Execute the candidate/proof identity check with a shared dependency, change that dependency, run invalidation, then replay using the original proof record.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run the stable-runner candidate identity test with a shared production dependency, mutate that dependency, and assert complete identity coverage, prior-proof invalidation, and same-identity replay.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Include shared production dependencies in candidate and regression identity, invalidate affected proof after later dependency changes, and preserve the original identity for replay.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Preserve existing candidate/proof record fields and historical evidence; invalidate only proofs whose bound shared dependency identity changes, while retaining the original identity for replay.

slice_hint.state_transition: Before: shared dependencies may be absent from proof identity and affected proof may remain current. After: dependencies are identity-bound, later changes invalidate affected proof, and replay reconstructs the same binding identity.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The targeted stable-runner identity test passes with complete dependency binding, deterministic invalidation after a dependency change, and same-identity replay.
